text.title: Cohort Implementation Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable warehouse and event-table signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres or Redshift) with a users table carrying signup timestamps and an events table carrying per-user events?

conclusion.verdict: no warehouse or no event table; use the analytics vendor's built-in cohort report instead

branch.question: Do events carry a stable post-identification user_id rather than only an anonymous or device id?

conclusion.verdict: resolve identity in staging first; do not build cohorts on anonymous ids

branch.question: Are signup and event timestamps stored in UTC, or convertible to UTC with a known source zone?

conclusion.verdict: add UTC columns in staging before truncating to cohort_week

branch.question: Is one retention event named in schema.yml and in settings.retention_event, with day_offsets declared?

conclusion.verdict: declare the event and offsets once; then generate the model
generate the incremental model with composite key, 90-day lookback, tests, and null immature cells in the chart spec
